title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
description: Given a string `s`, return the length of the longest palindromic subsequence in `s`. A subsequence is formed by deleting zero or more characters from `s` without changing the relative order of the remaining characters.
constraints: s consists only of lowercase English letters.
hints: Let dp[i][j] be the longest palindromic subsequence inside s[i..j].
If s[i] == s[j], dp[i][j] = dp[i + 1][j - 1] + 2; otherwise take max(dp[i + 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]). You can optimize space to O(n).

examples.explanation: "bbbb" is a palindromic subsequence of length 4.
"bb" is the longest palindromic subsequence of length 2.
All characters are distinct, so any single letter gives length 1.
